subject.title: Bug: Cron fallback chain broken — models return zero-token success or killed by shared AbortController

question: Should this issue wait for fresh current-main or post-release reproduction of the remaining abort/session symptoms, or should maintainers treat the source evidence plus related reports as sufficient to sponsor the timeout-budget fix path now?
rationale: The zero-result classifier bug is fixed on main, but the remaining abort-budget/session claim changes timeout policy and has not been live-proven after the classifier fix.

options.title: Require fresh proof first
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for configured timeout, per-attempt timestamps, abort reason/time, and resulting session model fields before promoting more work.

options.title: Sponsor timeout-budget repair
options.body: Use the current source evidence and related reports to drive a maintained, rebased version of the PR 52365 approach with current-head proof.

options.title: Split remaining work
options.body: Close or de-duplicate the classifier slice after release, but track timeout/session persistence under narrower issues such as the timeout-budget and cron fallback reports.

recommendation.title: Require fresh proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for configured timeout, per-attempt timestamps, abort reason/time, and resulting session model fields before promoting more work.

likelyOwner.reason: He landed the classifier fix and wrote the latest triage comment defining what evidence is still needed.
